newsitem.title: USA: Nine bidders in first US Stockpile palladium sale.
newsitem.headline: Nine bidders in first US Stockpile palladium sale.

text.p: Nine companies presented bids to the first U.S. Stockpile sale of surplus palladium.
The government is offering 15,000 ounces of palladium in the current fiscal year which ends September 30.
Each box varies from 500 to 600 ounces of palladium.
Degussa bid on 28 boxes at a price per ounce of 100.589 to 100.1695 percent of the London afternoon palladium fix.
Gerald Metals Inc bid for 28 boxes at 92 percent of the London fix.
Sabin bid on 28 boxes at 93.75 to 92.75 percent of the London fix.
J Aron and Co bid on 28 boxes at 95.5 percent of the fix.
A-1 Specialized bid on 28 boxes at 96.1 percent of the fix.
Johnson Matthey bid on 28 boxes at 98.6 to 98.35 percent of the fix.
Engelhard bid on 28 boxes at 97.7 percent of the fix.
Fleet Precious Metals bid on 28 boxes at 98 percent of the fix.
Complex Elements bid on 17 boxes at 95 percent of the fix.
